description:
Turn CSV and Excel files into a CREATE TABLE script or a direct import into SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB or SQLite.

GridDock reads a CSV, TSV, XLS or XLSX file, infers an editable table schema (integers, decimals, money, dates, right-sized strings), and then either writes a portable CREATE TABLE script or imports the rows over the database's own native connection, with no ODBC or OLE DB driver to install.
A preflight against the target database reports what would fail before anything is written, and saved recipes with a headless CLI handle scheduled runs. Loading files, schema review, recipes and SQL scripts are free. A Pro license ($29, one-time, including a year of updates) adds direct import, preflight checks and saved connections. Licenses are bought on the GridDock website through Lemon Squeezy's hosted checkout, which processes the payment; the app itself never handles payment details.
